question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: Career is the best-supported matter here: the Sun, lord of the 4th, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th, join in the 10th, forming Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga and Budhaditya yoga from the lagna [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja][rule:yoga.budhaditya].
